senses.gloss: m. (v. פָּרַשׁ) one who undertakes a voyage.
units: Gitt. VI, 5 המ׳ והיוצא וכ׳ one who starts for a sea voyage or a caravan journey.—Pl. מְפָרְשִׁים.—מְפָרְשֵׁי הים, מ׳ ימים sea-farers.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 2:1:4">Y. Sabb. II, beg. 4ᶜ</cite>, a. e. <he>חיזרתי על כל מ׳ ימים</he> I went around inquiring of all sea-faring people; (Bab.
